# ShipDataFast · Data Engineering Consulting

> Specialist data engineering consultancy helping engineering teams build reliable data flows, validate critical datasets, and reconcile differences between systems.

## Summary

ShipDataFast is an independent engineering consultancy founded by Ivano Mannella (TR Seeds Ltd), focusing on high-stakes data integrity across database migrations, core transaction processing, and system integrations. We offer hands-on data engineering consulting and two specialized software offerings: Data Reconciliation and Data Validation.

## Canonical Identity & Entity Signals
- **Entity**: ShipDataFast (Trading entity of TR Seeds Ltd)
- **Founder & Lead Engineer**: Ivano Mannella
- **Official Profiles**:

  - LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/ivanomannella/
- **Official Contact**: info@shipdatafast.com

## Core Offerings

### Consulting Services
- [Data Engineering](https://shipdatafast.com/services/data-engineering/): Architecture, integration contracts, transformation pipelines, and traceable handovers.
- [Data Validation](https://shipdatafast.com/services/data-validation/): Turning business data requirements into repeatable automated assertion checks.
- [Data Reconciliation](https://shipdatafast.com/services/data-reconciliation/): Defining matching contracts, timing cut-offs, and investigating cross-system differences.

### Software Offerings
- [Data Reconciliation](https://shipdatafast.com/products/reconciliation/): Comparison software answering "Where do these datasets disagree?" across two corresponding sources under explicit matching and tolerance rules.
- [Data Validation](https://shipdatafast.com/products/validation/): Rules-based evaluation answering "Does this data satisfy its rules?" for single datasets against mandatory presence, format patterns, and bounds.

## Key Facts & Operational Principles
- **Data Security**: Zero-trust, client-controlled architecture. No customer records or credentials are sent to external cloud platforms.
- **Auditable Outputs**: Every mismatch traces directly to explicit inputs and configured matching rules.
- **Sector Focus**: Financial services and fintech transaction reconciliation, applicable to all data-intensive systems.
